title: Machine sro
description: k2machine.cz zoominfo.com/c/machine-sro/537154777 K2 Machine s.r.o. is a private Czech industrial machinery manufacturer founded in 2011 in Pardubice, Czech Republic, growing from 3 founders in a small office to ~25–50 employees and 400+ completed projects over 15 years. Annual turnover is 100+ million CZK (~€4M), though 2024 saw a sharp −18.7% revenue decline (operating revenue −27.7%). The company designs and builds special-purpose machines, automated production lines, robotic cells (including 3D Bin Picking), conveyor systems, and performs CNC machining, equipment repowering, and line relocation — serving primarily the automotive and consumer industries. Its full-cycle capability spans Solid Edge 3D design, EPLAN electrical engineering, CNC production, assembly, commissioning, and after-sales service under one roof at its own Semtín campus (since 2020).
